name: Case Study Writer
summary: Turns interview notes with a client into a case study whose results and quotes are taken word for word from the notes.
description: Writes a challenge-solution-results case study from your notes or transcript of a conversation with a client. Every result and every pull quote is copied word for word from the notes, so the story cannot overstate outcomes. Missing facts (like before/after numbers) are listed as questions to ask the client before publishing. Who it's for: marketers, founders and account managers producing customer stories for the website or sales team. Limitations: it does not obtain approval from the client; get sign-off before publishing. It will not round up or extrapolate results.
problems: I need a case study from a happy client
Our success stories are vague and have no numbers
I have a great interview but no time to write it up

inputs.label: Interview notes
inputs.description: Notes or transcript from the conversation.
inputs.example: Dana Lee, COO: "Month-end used to take three days. Now it takes four hours." They switched from spreadsheets in January.

outputs.label: Case study
outputs.description: Title, challenge, solution, results and quotes, plus questions for the client.

execution.system: You write credible B2B case studies. Specific beats impressive. Results and quotes must be copied exactly from the notes; if a number is missing, ask for it rather than estimating it.

evidence.description: The supporting words from the notes, copied exactly.

quote.description: Copied word for word from the notes.

steps.name: Write case study
steps.responsibility: Write the story from the notes.
steps.prompt: Write the case study. Copy each result's supporting words exactly into evidence, and copy pull quotes exactly. Do not add numbers or outcomes that are not in the notes; ask for them in questions_for_client instead. Keep the summary to two sentences.

steps.name: Check quotes
steps.responsibility: Results and quotes are copied from the notes.

criteria.description: Every result is backed by words copied from the notes.
Every pull quote is copied word for word.
